column2: An End to Natural Dyes?

The discovery of man-made synthetic dyes in the mid-19th century triggered a long decline in the large-scale market for natural dyes. Synthetic dyes, which can be produced in large quantities, quickly superseded natural dyes for the commercial textile production enabled by the industrial revolution, and unlike natural dyes, are suitable for the synthetic fibres that followed. In a few of our provinces, the production of natural dyes is in a steady decline for a few years and now producers can barely sell their product. Faced with bankruptcy, most dye producers are looking for new goods to sell. We can help them look for new markets.
The Western Campaign
The Campaing to conquer the westernmost Slavs in Germanic lands is at hand
Unite the Kingdom of Lothair!

The Kingdom of Lotharingia is once again united after the long, gruesome conflict that engulfed the Karling realm. With the usurping rival of our king defeated soundly, once again there shall be a Carolingian kingdom on the world stage, prepared to solidify its role as the heir to the Holy Roman Emperor of old!
Reclaim the Kingdom of Burgundy!

The Kingdom of Burgundy lies directly to the south of the lands of Lothair, a former domain that must be reclaimed in short order. The king must take care to enforce this claim soon, as in this age of nationalism and ethnic unification the titles of old may soon become all but obsolete on the world stage.
The Karling King of Italy

When the Carolingian Empire first collapsed into utter ruin all those years ago and the kingdom of Lotharingia was born from its ashes, the lands of Northern Italy were assigned to Lothair. However, these lands were never easy to occupy, and despite the best efforts of Middle Frankia the lands of northern italy steadily fell away from the influence of the heirs to Charlemagne. Now, under the guidance of the latest of the house of Charlemagne, the kingdom of Italy can be reclaimed once again!
Centralize Parthia!

The northern lands of Parthia have long been a decentralized collection of tribal allegiances and tributary clients to the empire. As the nation of Parthia makes its way into the modern day, these arrangements must be updated to reflect the greater pull of the central government.
The Mongol Hand in China

The Mongol Empire was once the greatest empire in all of human history, stretching from the Pacific sea to the distant Black sea, menacing the greatest of Asian Empires at the same time as it marched upon the lands of Macedonia and Pannonia. With Peking in our hands once again, Mongolia shall fill the role of the Yuan dynasty of old, coming once again to dominate the lands of the east.
Annex the Tuvans

The Tuvan peoples lie as a vassal state of the great Mongol Empire, but lack the power or prestige to resist further integration by any means. it will be simple to reorganize them as a province once again.
Reclaim the Western Steppes

The Western Steppes were once united with the great Mongol Empire of old, but as the years have worn on these lands fell more and more into petty squabbling fiefdoms and miniscule khanates of little renown. Uniting these lands is essential if Mongolia is to reclaim its place at the center of the world.
Bring the Yakuts into the fold!

The Yakuts form the northeastern frontier of the Mongol steppes. The gateway into eastern siberia, these lands themselves are not worth much, but the peoples remain adjacent to the Mongol peoples and culture nonetheless, and so they must be united under the Khan.
The Horde marches west!

The Mongol Empire has once again united the steppes of central asia under its banner, but this is still not enough. The Empire must once again place itself at the gates of Europe as the greatest empire the world has ever seen, and it must unite the disparate Altaic peoples into one empire, under one Khan, destined to conquer the world.
Unite the Sogdians!

The Sogdians were, for much of the Classical period, the gateway to the steppes, and a prosperous merchant kingdom all their own. The Sogdian realm was wealthy and powerful, but years of disrepair and nomadic invasions have left this realm ruined. Unite Sogdia once more, and let the world remember the wealth and prestige it once held!
Become the Saoshyant!

The lands of Persia have been for centuries governed and controlled by the foreigner Manichaeans, whose heresy has steadily eroded the national and cultural fabric of the Zoroastrian peoples. The ancient Sassanids have remained all this time within their fortresses in the lands of Caucasia, awaiting the opportunity to bring back the true Mazdayan faith to the empire. Should Esfahan fall to the hands of the Sassanid peoples, this shall surely signal the end of foreign rule over Persia, and show the Sassanid Shah to be the truly prophesized Saoshyant, the savior of the world!
The Conquest of Anatolia

The lands of Anatolia were lost centuries ago at the hands of the migrating peoples of the Kurds and the Manichaean menace of the east. The ancient borderlands of the Roman Empire, the mountains and hills of Anatolia must be reclaimed if the empire is to ever recover from the rut the ruinous Hellenes drove it into.
The Levantine Crusade

Although the ancient crusading efforts to reclaim the holy lands of the Levant have ceased for many hundreds of years, the lands of the Levant remain deeply important to the Roman Empire of the east, and reviving this spirit of religious struggle within the population will prove deeply useful both for maintaining Latin rule in Constantinople and for restoring the ancient borders of the empire.
Reconquest of the Danube

The Danube frontier in the north was lost many years ago to the forces of migration and rot left behind by the ruinous Hellenes. The vitality of the empire cannot be considered secure as long as the very heartlands of the Latinokratia are under threat of siege from the northwest. Bringing these lands under heel will make the general population feel substantially more secure.
The Crusade for the Nile

Alexandria was long the mercantile and economic heart of the Eastern Empire before its loss at the hands of insurgency and disloyalty, doubtlessly spurred on by the treacherous Hellenes. Bring these lands back under control, and the East will once again remember its place within the Latin Empire
The Legacy of Trajan

The greatest territorial extent of the ancient empire of the Latins exists just within reach once more. The lands of Mesopotamia, ripe for the taking, will make for a fine eastern frontier. Destroying the Manichaean menace that has long brought such misery to the Christians of the West is the greatest imperative the empire could ever take upon itself, and the ecclesiastical authority of the ancient empire will never again be brought into question should success be achieved.
The Reclamation of Frisia.

My fellow citizens, today marks an important milestone in our nation's history. After hundreds of years of struggle, we have successfully reclaimed the coastal region of Frisia from its occupiers and brought it under the banner of the Saxon Empire. This achievement was made possible through the unwavering determination and bravery of our soldiers and the shrewd diplomacy of our leaders. Our victory in Frisia not only expands our territory but also secures our hold over the vital trade route of the North Sea coast.
The Recovery of Jütland

The reconquest of Jutland marks a turning point in our history. With this victory, we have not only expanded our territory, but we have also secured our borders against further aggression from the weakening Scandinavian Empire. As our power grows, so too does our responsibility to ensure the safety and prosperity of our people. We will not rest until every inch of our rightful territory is under our control, and we will continue to assert our dominance over the ever-weaker Scandinavian Empire.
Silesia is Ours!

It is my great pleasure to announce that Silesia is now officially under the control of the Saxon Empire. Through our unwavering persistence and tireless efforts, we have secured this coveted territory and expanded our influence in the region. This victory is a testament to the strength and determination of the Saxon people, and we will continue to pursue opportunities for expansion and defend our borders with the same tenacity. We look forward to the opportunities and prosperity that this new addition to our empire will bring.
The Reclamation of Batavia

With great pride and honor, we announce that the old land of Batavia is once again under the control of the mighty Saxon Empire. Our armies have triumphed over adversity, and we have reclaimed this vital territory that rightfully belongs to us. This victory further cements our position as a dominant force in Europe, and we will continue to defend our borders and expand our territories. Let this achievement serve as a reminder to all that the glory of the Saxon Empire is unmatched, and that we will not rest until we have achieved our rightful place as the greatest Empire in north europe.
Claim lands in Pomerania

With the lands of the Saxon Empire fully restored to their rightful place, we now turn our gaze towards Pomerania. This region presents a valuable opportunity for expansion and growth, and we have the strength and resources to make it our own. The Saxon Empire has proven itself to be a dominant force in Europe, and we will continue to pursue opportunities to expand our borders and establish ourselves as the greatest civilization on the continent. Let us move forward with confidence and determination, knowing that our victory in securing our rightful lands has strengthened us for the challenges that lie ahead.
The march to the east.

With our previous campaigns having brought great success to the Saxon Empire, the time has come to turn our attention towards the weak and vulnerable Polish people to the east. Their lands present a valuable opportunity for expansion, and we have the strength and resources to crush their resistance and bring them under our rule. Let us not hesitate in pursuing this great victory, for it will only serve to further strengthen our position as the dominant power in Europe. We will continue to move forward with unwavering determination, knowing that the glory of the Saxon Empire will only continue to grow with each new conquest.
Integrate the eastern lands.

With the conquest of the eastern lands in Poland, the Saxon Empire has demonstrated its power and dominance over the region. Now, it is time to turn our attention towards our fellow Germans, who have long been separated from us by artificial borders. We extend an invitation to them to join us as a core part of the Saxon Empire, to be united with us in our shared culture and heritage. Let us not allow borders to divide us any longer
column3: we are one people, united in our commitment to the greatness of our civilization. Together, we will continue to expand our empire and pursue new opportunities for growth and prosperity.

column2: The Western Rhine.

With the successful acquisition of all possible German claims, the time has come to assert our dominance over the western lands, which have long been controlled by the Franks. We have defeated their armies and demonstrated our superiority on the battlefield, and now it is time to make it clear to the world that these lands rightfully belong to Germany. Let there be no doubt: the German Empire is the most powerful and dominant force in Europe, and we will not be deterred in our quest for greatness. The Western lands will be brought under our control, and we will continue to pursue new opportunities for expansion and growth. Let our enemies tremble at the sound of our approach, for they will be powerless to stop us. The glory of Germany will shine bright for all to see, and we will continue to assert our dominance over the continent with unwavering determination.
Integration of all Saxons.

As the Saxon Empire continues to grow and expand, we recognize the importance of integrating all of our people into a larger, unified nation. This includes those smaller groups of German Saxons who may have previously been separated from the rest of our people. We welcome them into our society with open arms, and will work tirelessly to ensure their full inclusion in all aspects of our culture and governance. Only through such unity can we continue to build a strong and prosperous future for the Saxon Empire, and we are committed to making it a reality.
Integrate the southern Germans.

As Germany continues to expand and grow, we recognize the importance of integrating all of our people into a larger, unified nation. This includes the Germans living in the southeastern regions, who may have previously been separated from the rest of our people. We welcome them into our society with open arms, and will work tirelessly to ensure their full inclusion in all aspects of our culture and governance. Only through such unity can we continue to build a strong and prosperous future for Germany, and we are committed to making it a reality.
The invasion of the Baltic Sea

The time has come for the German Empire to once again pursue its old ambitions in the Baltic region. Having fulfilled all of our previous claims and conquered all possible territories within our reach, we must now look beyond our borders to new lands ripe for conquest. The Baltic holds great strategic importance for our nation, and we will not rest until it is firmly under our control. We will marshal our armies and unleash them upon the weak and disorganized peoples of the region, crushing all who stand in our way. Let it be known that the German Empire is a force to be reckoned with, and we will stop at nothing to achieve our goals. The glory of Germany will shine bright in the Baltic, and we will continue to assert our dominance over the continent with unwavering determination.
An odd claim on tyrol?

It's somewhat amusing to think that the German nation could claim Tirol based on some flimsy historical claims made by other Germans. While it's true that Tirol has been passed back and forth between various powers over the centuries, it hardly seems fair to stake a claim to it now just because some long-dead Germans once had control over the region. Nevertheless, if the German people truly believe that Tirol is rightfully theirs, then it is their prerogative to make such a claim. Whether or not it will be taken seriously by the rest of the world remains to be seen, but it's certainly an interesting topic for debate.
Commence The Integration of the Baltic

With the conquest of the Baltic Sea now complete, the German Empire can turn its attention to the arduous task of integrating the conquered peoples into the greater German nation. While some may see this as a daunting challenge, we see it as an opportunity to expand our influence and bring new blood into our great nation. We will begin by establishing a strong presence in the region, with military garrisons and administrative centers set up to maintain order and facilitate the integration process. Our people will work tirelessly to spread German culture and values throughout the Baltics, with the goal of creating a new generation of true Germans who will proudly call themselves members of the greater German Empire. While this task will undoubtedly take time and effort, we are confident that the rewards will be great, and we look forward to welcoming the people of the Baltic into our ranks as loyal citizens of the German nation.
Restore the Baltic dominions

My fellow Nordics, it is with great pride and gratitude that I announce to you the successful conclusion of the war with Bolkania over our beloved Baltic coast. After months of bloody conflict, our brave soldiers have emerged victorious, and our control over the region can now be fully restored. The sacrifices made by our people will not be forgotten, and the memory of our fallen heroes will be forever honored. I call upon all Nordics to join me in celebrating this momentous occasion and to work together in rebuilding our nation stronger than ever before.
The pruski must submit!

As the Nordic Empire continues its conquest of the Baltics, we have identified a unique opportunity to expand our control over the Pruski lands. With the Bolkanian hold on the region weakened by our successful military campaign, we believe that the time is ripe to move in and assert our dominance over the Pruski vassals. We are prepared to use all necessary means to secure our control over these territories, and we have full confidence in our military capabilities to overcome any challenges that may arise. This expansion of our empire will bring stability and prosperity to the region, and we look forward to the many opportunities that it will offer.
Embrace the Albidosaek!
They will now be acccepted in our nation
The purchase of the pearl of Himilconis
With the recent developments for the Franks maintaining the colony may be unnecessarily costly for them and they might find themselves willing to sell it to us for the right price.
The Fate of the new world.

The time has come for us to extend our hand to those poor colonies that have been struggling to govern themselves in the Americas. They have been suffering for far too long, and it is time for them to once again experience the peace and prosperity that can only come from being under the wing of the great Frankish nation. It is our duty to bring civilization and order to these lands, to teach these people the proper way of governing and living. We know that some may see this as an act of conquest, but we must remember that it is for their own good. It is not exploitation, but rather, it is an act of benevolence towards those who have been lost without our guidance.
Embrace the peoples of the Alps

After many long years of conflict and strife, the Franks have finally recovered their rightful lands around the Alps. With this victory, the time has come for us to properly integrate the peoples of these lands into the larger Frankish nation. It is our duty to ensure that all who dwell within our borders share in the prosperity and security that our great nation provides. Let us work together to forge a bright future for all Franks, wherever they may be found.
Accept the allemani into the nation.
Given the historical and geographical ties of the peoples in the southwest of Germany to the rest of the country, it is only logical to consider them as integral parts of the nation.
The incans will not be free.

With the reclamation of the last Frankish colonies in the Americas, the glorious Frankish empire sets its sights on the South. The traitorous Incas who dare challenge our sovereignty will face the full might of the Frankish army. We will teach them that the price of rebellion is nothing less than total annihilation. Their lands, their people, and their resources will all become part of the great Frankish empire. Let this be a warning to all who would oppose us, for our destiny is to rule the world with an iron fist.
The Reclamation of Savoy

Following the successful reclamation of Savoy under the Frankish banner, it is only logical that all of its lands now become an integral part of the Frankish nation. The people of Savoy shall be welcomed with open arms as brothers and sisters.
Burgundy just isnt my colour.

It is with great satisfaction that we can announce the subjugation of the Burgundian people and their land under the rule of the Frankish Empire. This victory has been a long time coming, but with our military might and unwavering determination, we have finally brought the wayward Burgundians back into the fold of our great nation. Let this be a warning to any who would dare challenge the might of the Frankish Empire, for we will not rest until all lands and peoples are brought under our just and rightful rule.
Form The Celtic Union.

The long-awaited moment has finally arrived, after endless battles and countless sacrifices, the true celtic peoples of the British Isles and beyond have been granted a sovereign state that recognizes them as the rightful owners of their homeland. It is a moment of great joy and pride, for the blood, sweat, and tears shed in the name of this cause were not in vain. This is a triumph of the spirit, a victory for all those who have fought for their identity, their heritage, and their culture. The flame of freedom and independence now burns bright in the heart of every celtic man and woman, and it will continue to shine for generations to come.
The island of Apples.

With great pride and joy, we declare that the people of the colony of Avalon in the lands of apples are now part of the greater Celtic Union. Their people and culture are an essential part of our shared heritage, and we welcome them with open arms. Their contributions to our society and our history will be cherished and celebrated as we continue to strengthen our bond as a united Celtic people. Together, we will build a better future for all of our citizens, and we will face any challenges that come our way with courage and determination.
The Albidosaek are ours now.

After many long years, the people of Prydain have finally claimed the land of Alban, which had been under the oppressive rule of the Scandinavian Empire for far too long. With the might of their armies and the strength of their spirits, the Celtic people of Prydain have driven out the invaders and now the land rightfully belongs to its true owners. The people of Alban are now free to live as part of the greater Celtic nation, and their traditions and culture will be celebrated and preserved as an integral part of the proud heritage of the Celtic peoples.
No more Danelaw.

Under the brave leadership of our military, the Scandinavian invaders have been driven out of the Aengliscs lands. After years of oppression and struggle, we have finally reclaimed our ancestral land and it rightfully belongs to us. Our people can now live in peace and prosperity, free from the tyranny of the foreign conquerors. Let this be a reminder that our resolve is unbreakable, and we will never yield in our quest to defend our homeland and secure our future.
The Reclamation of our Lands.

As the sun rises over Constantinople, I stand before you to declare that the time has come for the Eastern Roman Empire to reclaim what is rightfully ours. For too long, our lands have been taken from us by foreign powers, and it is time to put an end to this injustice. We shall not rest until our lands are back under our control, and our people are once again living in peace and prosperity. Let this be a call to arms for all those who love our empire and wish to see it restored to its former glory. The Eastern Roman Empire shall rise again, and our enemies will tremble before us!
The Reclamation of Anatolia

The Byzantine Empire hereby declares that the time has come for Anatolia to be reclaimed as Roman once more. The land that was once rightfully under the rule of Rome has been taken from us for too long. The Byzantine Empire will not rest until it has regained full control of Anatolia, and we will use all means necessary to achieve this goal. The time for complacency is over, and we will not stop until our land is returned to us.
The balkans are Roman!
Centralize Rumelia
Hold a Triumph for Rome!

The Eternal City of Rome has languished for centuries outside of the rightful rule of its Rhomaion progenitors. Cast away from the hold of the civilized world by the work of Germanic barbarians and disloyal patriarchs, the city now once again rests in Rhomaion hands once again, a symbol of the greatness of ages past and the new heights the people of Constantinople have achieved. With the disloyal and apostate Pope towed behind the proceeding armies, the Rhomaion army shall march through the Eternal city as conquerors and liberators alike, demonstrating our superiority and restored rule over the lesser, barbaric Latins of the West.
Rally the Cosenzan League

The so-called Italian peninsula, known rightfully as Magna Graecia, remains a territory of great interest to the Rhomaion empire, even though it has languished outside of Imperial hands since our defeat by the Carthaginians in the 1547 Battle of the Adriatic. The recent unification of Southern Italy in a confederation under the Melfis-based monarchy generates a unique opportunity for us to present ourselves in the region once again. Should we introduce our own influences into the kingdom, we may be able to exploit divisions between the mainland monarchies and the Cosenzan League, the only republic of the trio to join the confederation, to trigger a Cosenzan-led coup in favor of Byzantine influence. Even should the coup fail, it opens a welcome casus belli to enforce Byzantine rule over southern Italy.
Hold a Triumph for Italy!

The preparations are all but complete for our final reintegration of Italia into the one true Rhomaion Empire! Soon, all shall see that the one true Rome is indivisible, eternal, governed by those ordained by the Angel of God Herself! None shall question our power and divinity, for both the chief point of the star of David and its lesser partner in the west now form the basis of East and West, revealing to all that the promise of God goes to us and us alone!
The Reclamation of Armenia

The Armenian territories have not been a part of the Rhomaion realm for many years now. Not since the loss of Anatolia centuries ago to Kachuskaya has the land been within reach for the Rhomaion people. Yet, with the end of Kachuskaya, it is only a matter of time before the Rhomaion eagle flies over the Caucasus once again.
Rebuilding the Parthenon

The Parthenon was once the religious and cultural heart of the Hellenic realm. Now, long since conquered by the Usurpers, the temple has fallen into utter ruin and disrepair. However, with a great deal of funding from the state, an effort can be made to not only reconstruct the Parthenon, but fully place the myriad temples of Hellas under firm state control, permanently rending the ties between the Hellenic realm and the western world that abandoned it.
Integrate the Finno-Ugrics.
The finno ugric states in the scandinavian empire can now be properly integrated into the nation.
Integrate Finland into Scandinavia

As the borders of the Scandinavian Empire expand, it is only natural that Finland, with its rich cultural and historical ties to the Nordic peoples, be integrated into the greater empire. The Finns have long been a part of the Scandinavian sphere of influence, and now that their land is rightfully under the control of the empire, it is time to fully embrace them as brothers and sisters in the Nordic family. Through shared language, culture, and history, Finland can contribute to the strength and prosperity of the Scandinavian Empire, and the empire can provide security and stability for the Finnish people.
Integrate The Baltics Further.

With the successful integration of Finland the time has come for us to expand our direct control over the Baltic. Our Baltic subjects have long been loyal to us and it is only natural that we seek to annex their lands and incorporate them into the greater empire.
The eastern Baltic is ours.
As Lithuania has been successfully integrated into the Scandinavian Empire it is only fitting that the people of the Baltic states unite under the banner of the Scandinavian Empire.
The eastern subject.

In light of recent developments, it is only natural that we consider integrating the Eastern Slavic administration into our larger Scandinavian Empire. The Eastern Slavs have long been our neighbors, and their cultures and traditions are intertwined with ours. By integrating them into our nation, we can better ensure their protection and prosperity, while also strengthening our own power and influence in the region. It is time for us to work together as one united people, bound by a common purpose and a shared destiny.
The Western lands at the end of the World.

Far, Far to the west... there is a land named vinland...a land of peace and green as far as the eye can see, vast and rich, found by and settled by our ancestors who seeked new lands to live in away from all the troubles of europe, that green land that has been part of our subjects for such a long time, considerably more peaceful compared to the troubles in europe, despite the many struggles against other colonizing efforts by our rivals and old subjects the green and vast lands of vinland lie there, awaiting to be made a true part of scandinavia, let it be know that the Nordic Empire RULES ALL OVER THE NORTHERN SEAS! UNDISPUTED AND GRAND! THE NORTHERN EDGE OF THE WORLD BELONGS TO NO ONE ELSE BUT US!
The Restoration Of Nordumbren.

Following a hard-fought war in Britannia, the Scandinavian forces have emerged victorious and now have the opportunity to reclaim their former subject of Nordumbren. The triumph against the Celtic forces marks a turning point in the conflict, and the Scandinavian people eagerly look forward to reintegrating their once-loyal subjects into the fold of the larger empire. With Nordumbren back under Scandinavian control, the empire stands stronger than ever before.
The Destruction of the celts has come.

As the Prydish forces have met their ultimate defeat, the Nordic empire shall take this opportunity to reclaim their rightful land in the Isles of Brittania. The time has come to destroy the Prydish nation and reestablish the old borders that were once held by the Nordic empire. May this victory serve as a reminder of our strength and determination to protect what is rightfully ours.
DOMINIS MARIS BALTICI!

DOMINIS MARIS BALTICI! The time has finally come for the Nordic Empire to claim its rightful dominion over the lands and peoples of the Baltic. With our borders encircling the sea and our armies firmly in control of the surrounding territories, we can declare ourselves the true masters of the Baltic. Our culture and way of life shall now spread throughout these lands, bringing prosperity and unity to all those who accept our rule. Let this be a new era of greatness for the Nordic Empire and the Baltic peoples under our benevolent guidance.
Reclaiming Illyria

After many years of struggle and perseverance, Venice has finally been able to reclaim its rightful lands in Illyria. With the support of its allies and the determination of its people, Venice has overcome numerous obstacles to achieve this long-awaited victory. The people of Illyria can now look forward to a bright future under the just and benevolent rule of the Venetian Republic.
Embrace the Dalmatians.
With the successful recovery of their rightful lands in Illyria, Venice can now begin the process of properly integrating the people into their society.
Tyrol is ours.

After a long and hard-fought campaign, Venice has succeeded in conquering the region of Tirol and has declared it a core territory. The people of Tirol will now be integrated into the Venetian nation.
The end of the Lombards.

As the smoke settles and the blood dries, it is clear that the end has come for Lombardia and Aquilea. Their armies have been crushed, their cities have been sacked, and their leaders have been slain. Venice has emerged victorious, and her flag now flies high over the ruins of their once-great nation. Let it be known that these lands are now rightfully Venetian, and no other nation shall dare to claim them as their own. The people of Lombardia and Aquilea shall now know the peace and prosperity that comes with being a part of the mighty Venetian Republic.
Subjugate The North.

After grueling battles, the forces of Toledo have emerged victorious in their campaign to assert dominance over the northern regions of Iberia. Despite the interference of outside powers, like africa, the armies of Toledo persevered and claimed their rightful place as rulers of the region. The people of Iberia can now look forward to a new era of stability and prosperity under the leadership of Toledo.
The south is wide open!

The council of generals couldn't believe their luck: while the Carthaginians were distracted by the Italian front, they had a golden opportunity to strike at their foes in the south of Iberia. It had been decades since their people had been expelled from those lands, and the memory of that defeat still stung. But now, with a powerful army and a clever strategy, they could finally reclaim what was rightfully theirs. The generals smiled at each other, feeling the thrill of adventure and conquest. They knew the risks were high, but the rewards were even higher. This was their chance to shine and make history.
Integrate Pomerania

After years of possessing and fighting over the lands in Pomerania, the Nordic nation can finally lay a proper claim to the territory as a true core of the nation. The Nordic people have struggled and bled to establish their dominion over the region, and now they can finally rest assured that it is a rightful part of their homeland. With the integration of Pomerania into the Nordic empire, the nation can now focus on consolidating its power and building a better future for all its citizens.
Let our banner rise across the grand steppe.

The dream of a unified Slavic nation has been long pursued by the people of the region, and after many struggles and sacrifices, that dream can finally be realized. The Slavic peoples have endured centuries of oppression and foreign rule, but their shared history, culture, and language have kept their bond strong. Now, with the successful unification of all Slavic nations, a new era of prosperity, security, and self-determination can begin. The Slavic nation will stand tall among the other great nations of the world, representing the unity, strength, and resilience of its people.
Unite north Italy.
Now that the various states of northern Italy have been brought under one major influence, the time has come to unite the region into the nation of Padania.
The western border.

After a period of rebellion and unrest, the Pruskys have finally been pacified and subdued. With the situation now under control, we can move forward with towards properly annexing the Western territories into the nation, we will make sure this isn't repeated from either the Poles or Pruskys.
The south is under control.

After many years of conflicts and struggles, the southern subject of Bolkania is now firmly under the control of the Bolkanian authorities. The region is finally stable and ready to be integrated into the greater Bolkanian nation. With this accomplishment, Bolkania can now focus on the task of rebuilding and consolidating its newly expanded territories, bringing prosperity and stability to the people of the south.
The Dream of two Coasts

Selbapunnica, a powerful empire in the Andronican region, has long dreamed of expanding its territories to include the coveted western coast. Despite numerous attempts in the past, the empire has been unsuccessful in its conquests. However, recent events have put Selbapunnica in a unique position to pursue this goal once again. The empire has strengthened its military power, solidified its alliances, and secured important resources necessary for a successful campaign. With the current instability in the region, Selbapunnica sees an opportunity to strike and fulfill its long-standing ambition. The question now is whether the empire is willing to take the risk and commit to a costly war to achieve its objectives.
Unite Andronica

The time has come for us to unite the Andronican continent. Together, we can harness the collective strength of our nations and overcome any obstacle. Let us put aside our differences and work towards a common goal - to establish a new era of prosperity and stability for all the peoples of Andronica. We have the opportunity to leave a lasting legacy, one that will be remembered for generations to come. Let us seize it with unwavering determination and unyielding resolve.

Close the Borders

A closed border is a border that prevents movement of people between different jurisdictions with limited or no exceptions associated with this movement. These borders normally have fences or walls in which any gates or border crossings are closed and if these border gates are opened they generally only allow movement of people in exceptional circumstances. In case of emigration as well as immigrations, departing ships are inspected for illegal emigrants. These controls and checks come at the cost of an increased demand from the State's bureaucracy.
Implement Immigration Quotas

A conditionally open border is a border that allows movement of people across the border that meet a special set of conditions. This special set of conditions which limits the application of border controls that would normally otherwise apply could be defined by an international agreement or international law, or the special conditions could be defined by a regulation or law of the jurisdiction that the people are claiming the right to enter. Conditionally open borders generally requires a claim to be submitted from the people who are proposing to enter the new jurisdiction stating why they meet the special conditions which allow entry into the new jurisdiction. In the case of our country, quotas mean that no foreigners that fail a literacy test in their own language or are nationals of countries that were or are at war with our nation are allowed. These controls and checks come at the cost of an increased demand from the State's bureaucracy.
Abolish Immigration Restrictions

An open border is a border that enables free movement of people between different jurisdictions with limited or no restrictions on movement. A border may be an open border due to intentional legislation allowing free movement of people across the border, or a border may be an open border due to lack of adequate enforcement or adequate supervision of the border. One of the advantages of such a policy is that it requires little to none effort from the State's bureaucracy to keep control over immigrants.

Having enjoyed prosperity and control over their own affairs, and having remained loyal subjects for nearly a century, the manifesto which the $MONARCHTITLE$ issued on $YEAR$ was cause for Finnish despair. The manifesto was forced through the Finnish senate by the deciding vote of the senate president, an appointee of the $MONARCHTITLE$ — and after the governor-general of Finland, Nikolay Bobrikov, had threatened a military invasion and siege. While ostensibly affirming the Finns' rights in purely local matters, the manifesto asserted the authority of the state in any and all matters which could be considered to "come within the scope of the general legislation of the empire". The main policies enacted were:
The conscription law, incorporating the Finnish army into the imperial army.
The Language Manifesto of $YEAR$ which made Russian the language of administration of Finland.
The Orthodox Russian Church was the church of state, including, for example, criminalizing the act of subjecting a follower of the Orthodox church to a Lutheran church service.
The Manifesto of $YEAR$ which asserted the imperial government's right to rule Finland without the consent of local legislative bodies, including press censorship and restrictions of Russian currency and stamps as the only ones allowed.
Our Finnish subjects will surely not like this and they might try to resist.
Press our Claims in Neuchatel
We can try to pressure Switzerland over our claim in Neuchatel to finally settle the issue over the ownership of the territory. This will, however, anger the Great Powers of Europe.
Access to the Rhineland

Relations with the ruler of Kassel have been shaky for some time, improving or deteriorating in these turbulent times. Due to conditions beyond our control, they are now forbidding our troops from marching through Kassel to annex our western provinces. This is a direct challenge to $COUNTRY$, which under conventions with the elector has the right to the use of the military roads through Hesse that are our sole means of communication with our Rhine provinces. We can't be cut off like this - immediate action is necessary to secure access to the Rhine.
First Stage of the CNR
The first stage of the Canadian National Railway, linking Winnipeg to the Atlantic Coast, has been completed. Now work must begin on the second stage, which will be considerably more difficult.
Second Stage of the CNR

The second stage of the Canadian National Railway, linking Calgary to the Atlantic Coast, has been completed. Now work must begin on the last stage, which will be the longest and most difficult yet as it requires creating a pass through the Rocky Mountains themselves.
Finish the CNR

After a massive effort expended to create a pass through the Rocky Mountains, the Canadian National Railway has been completed! A single railway now links the Pacific coast to the Atlantic. Crowds have gathered in $CAPITAL$ to celebrate the first locomotive being sent to make the complete journey!
Cede Aden to Yemen

In order to cement our relation with Yemen we should further our decolonization efforts and cede Aden to them. It will mean the loss of a strategic important port, but it will improve our reputation in the eyes of the other powers of the world.
Adopt a Writing System

Our society has worked without a writing system for centuries. The foreign missionaries use these symbols to communicate with each other and to leave notes. If we were to, with their help, codify our language and teach our people, maybe we can become as powerful as the countries they come from.
Van Diemen's Land Penal Colony

In 1803 the island south of Australia was colonized by the British as a penal colony with the name Van Diemen's Land, and became part of the British colony of New South Wales. Male convicts served their sentences as assigned labor to free settlers or in gangs assigned to public works. Only the most difficult convicts (mostly re-offenders) were sent to the Tasman Peninsula prison known as Port Arthur. Female convicts were assigned as servants in free settler households or sent to a female factory (women's workhouse prison). There were five female factories in Van Diemen's Land. Convicts completing their sentences or earning their ticket-of-leave often promptly left Van Diemen's Land. Many settled in the new free colony of Victoria, to the dismay of the free settlers in towns such as Melbourne.\n\nWe can abolish the penal colony and convert the island to a regular colony. Changing the name to Tasmania from Van Diemen's Land should help our government to clear a little bit of the stigma that the island has.
Claim the Argentinian Chaco

The Gran Chaco has been a disputed territory since 1810. Officially, it was supposed to be part of Argentina, Bolivia and Paraguay, although a bigger land portion west of the Paraguay River has belonged to Paraguay since its independence. It's for us to make good on our claims in the area.
Restore the Baltic German Nobility

Baltic Germans have lived in the Baltic States for a long time and while they were once one of the dominant forces in the region, they no longer hold any power in the government or society. As the Baltic States are under our protection and control, we should reinstall the German nobility to serve us better.
Integrate Lithuania in the Baltic States

Although not considered part of the Baltic States proper, Lithuania is small enough to be added to the Baltic Administration. This wouldn't please the Lithuanians at all and the only way it can be done is through force, but it would make managing our Baltic Allies easier.
The $YEAR$ Compromise

Senators Henry Clay and Stephen A. Douglas have presented a draft proposal for a compromise on the slavery issue centered around the premise of popular sovereignty as the determinant for slavery or abolitionism in the territories. By supporting the draft proposal, we could calm tensions over the slavery issue for at least some time. The compromise is a package of five separate bills which will defuse a four-year political confrontation between slave and free states regarding the status of territories acquired during the Mexican-American War. The mains points are:
1. Texas surrenders its claim to New Mexico, over which it had threatened war, as well as its claims north of the Missouri Compromise Line. It retains the Texas Panhandle and the federal government will took over the state's public debt.
2. California is admitted as a free state with its current boundaries.
3.The Wilmot Proviso will be fully rejected.
4.The slave trade (but not slavery altogether) will be banned in Washington D.C.
The Conakry Protectorate

Since the 18th century, Portuguese, British and French traders had established small stations on the coast which was called Rivières du Sud by the French. The Portuguese had trading stations at Rio Pongo and Rio Nunez, mostly for the purchase of enslaved Africans captured inland and brought to the coast. By 1820, British suppression of the slave trade and Portuguese imperial decline saw these posts abandoned, with British and French traders moving in. The French admiral Bouët-Willaumez made a number of treaties with coastal communities in the area (usually under the threat of force), and ensured Marseilles based trade houses exclusive access to the palm oil trade by the 1840s. Used for making soap, the palm oil trade was with Diola merchants who established markets in the interior, and transported it to the coastal stations. We can formalize the colonial structure of these trade posts and routes to effectively take control of Conakry.
The Senegal-Guinea Border Treaty

A dispute arose with another country over our colonial borders in Senegal and Guinea. $COUNTRY_ADJ$ citizens poured and live in Ziguinchor province. According to the principles of Effective Occupation established in Conference of Berlin, the territory belong to us. But it has been under rule of another nation for a long time and thus the dispute arose. Our diplomats are trying to organize an exchange - Gabu for Ziguinchor, now we just need to propose this deal to our good neighbors.
The Occupation of Western Sahara

While in the Berlin Conference, whereat the European powers were establishing the rules for setting up zones of influence or protection in Africa was ongoing, $COUNTRY$ declared "a protectorate of the African coast" from Cape Blanc to Cape Bojador on $YEAR$. Under the principle of Effective Occupation established by the Berlin Conference, the need to effectively control the area to have the claim recognized was established, and that's what $COUNTRY$ is doing.
The Austrian - Hungarian Border Treaty

Our diplomats are drafting a friendship and border treaty between ourselves and our neighbors, to settle outstanding issues between the perceived territory of the two countries. The treaty would include population exchanges, border delimitation and a treaty of friendship. If we sign this deal it will also show the world our will to settle issues diplomatically and our government respect of the will of the people.
The Fiume Question

Although Croatia had constitutional autonomy within Hungary, the City of Fiume was independent, governed (as a corpus separatum) directly from Budapest by an appointed governor, as Hungary's only international port. Our claims and ties to Fiume are strong and its naval base and port would play an important role in serving us.
The Italian States

The unification of Italy wasn't a smooth process and the result was local autonomy in the old states that composed Italy. We need an united nation and to accomplish that we must abolish local self rule and privileges.
The Canadian Lands
Some of the lands claimed by our Canadian dominion are still under our direct control, and transferring sovereignty to them would greatly help our relations.
The Guantanamo Bay Lease

The Guantanamo Bay in the island of Cuba is the largest natural harbor on the south side of the island and it is surrounded by steep hills which create an enclave that is cut off from its immediate hinterland. It would make an excellent coaling station and it's natural harbor would allow for ships to stay there during the hurricane seasons while allowing us to project our power in the Caribbean. Some of our best diplomats can prepare a lease document to justify our use of such strategic territory.
Buy the Virgin Islands

The Virgin Islands were originally inhabited by the Arawak, Carib, and Cermic, all of whom are thought to have perished during the colonial period. The owner of the islands of St. Thomas, Saint John and Saint Croix, the Virgin Islands we are looking to buy, are poorly managing them for decades, and now they are costing them money - a lot. There are still some elements that resist selling the islands to us but - with the right conditions - we might be able to make an offer they can't deny.
Encourage the Amazon Rubber Boom

The rubber boom or Ciclo da borracha was an important part of the economic and social history of Brazil and Amazonian regions of neighboring countries, being related to the extraction and commercialization of rubber. Centered in the Amazon Basin, the boom resulted in a large expansion of European colonization in the area, attracting immigrant workers, generating wealth and causing cultural and social transformations. It encouraged the growth of cities such as Manaus, Porto Velho, and Belém, capitals within the respective Brazilian states of Amazonas, Rondônia and Pará.
Organize Namibia

We should organize the African colonies to better reflect both a local structure, as well as set up the possibility for autonomous rule -- dominated by our benevolent colonial administrators, of course.
Integrate Kazakhstan
With the central states in Asia under our control, the only one remaining is Kazakhstan. It's time we make it an integral part of Russia.
Greater Tibet
The Tibetan Empire once ruled a vast land that was taken away from us by the barbarians. The Tibetan people still live in these lands and the time has come for us the claim whats historically ours.
Reorganize Timor
Now that we have taken possession of Dili, we should reorganize its structure to make it truly part of our greater colonial administration.
Organize Timor
To better take advantage of our colonies in Timor, we should organize and centralize the administration while modernizing the country just enough to have a modern infrastructure.
Abolish Wallachia and Moldavia
The old divisions of Wallachia and Moldavia are now all but obsolete, Romania is united and the princely titles exist no more. It's time to abolish these obsolete divisions once and for all.
Abolish Transylvania
The old division of Transylvania is now all but obsolete, Romania is united and the princely titles exist no more. It's time to abolish these obsolete divisions once and for all.
The Saint Barthélemy Question

The island of Saint Barthélemy had belonged to France until 1784, when it was transferred to Sweden in return for trade privileges in Gothenburg. However, the island proved expensive to maintain. We can push for an agreement and a referendum on the island status and future, but there's always the chance that they might cede the island to another power to avoid conflict with us. Even if we lost the referendum, we will still be able to claim the island.
Adopt the Shinbutsu Bunri

The Japanese term shinbutsu bunri indicates the separation of Shinto from Buddhism, introduced after the Meiji Restoration, and therefore the separation of kami (native Shinto deities) from Buddhas (Buddhist deities), and of Buddhist temples from Shinto shrines (jinja). Until the end of the Edo period Shinto and Buddhism were intimately connected in what was called shinbutsu-shugo, to the point that the same buildings were often used as both Shinto shrines and Buddhist temples, and Shinto gods were interpreted as manifestations of Buddhas. The new government saw shinbutsu bunri as a way to reduce the immense wealth and power of the Buddhist sects. At the same time, it was supposed to give Shinto, and especially its cult of the Emperor, time to grow into an effective vehicle for nationalism. A first order issued by the Jingijimuka on $YEAR$ ordered the defrocking of shaso and betto (shrine monks performing Buddhist rites at Shinto shrines). A few days later, the Daijokan banned the application of Buddhist terminology such as gongen to Japanese kami and the veneration of Buddhist statues in shrines. Next came a ban on applying the Buddhist term Daibosatsu (Great Bodhisattva) to the syncretic kami Hachiman at the Iwashimizu Hachiman-gu and Usa Hachiman-gu shrines.In the final stage, all the defrocked betto and shaso were told to become "shrine priests" (kannushi) and return to their shrines. Also, monks of the Nichiren sect were told not to refer to some deities as kami.
The Imperial Rescript on Education

Following the Meiji Restoration, the leadership of the Meiji government felt the need to emphasize the common goals of rapid modernization (westernization) with support and legitimization of the political system centered on the imperial institution. In the 1870s and 1880s, Motoda Nagazane and other conservatives pushed for a revival of the principles of Confucianism as a guide for education and public morality
column3: however, Inoue Kowashi and other proponents of the 'modernization' of Japan felt that this would encourage a return to the old feudal order, and pushed for an "emperor-centered" philosophy. Prime Minister Yamagata Aritomo authorized the drafting of the Rescript, which was a compromise written largely by Inoue Kowashi with input from Motoda Nagazane and others. After it was issued, the Rescript was distributed to all schools in the country, together with a portrait of Emperor Meiji.

column2: The Selangor Resident

In the 19th century the importance of Selangor greatly increased by the rapid expansion of tin mining as a result of the increased demand for tin from the West. The desire to control the Klang Valley led directly to the Selangor Civil War (also called the Klang War) when Raja Mahdi fought to regain what he considered his birthright as territorial chief against Raja Abdullah. In $YEAR$ however, a ship from Penang was attacked by pirates near Kuala Langat, Selangor. After a number of piracy attacks took place in Selangor, a $COUNTRY_ADJ$ Resident was assigned as a live-in advisor to Sultan Abdul Samad, making the rule a mere puppet.
The Perak Resident

In $YEAR$, the Sultan of Perak went to $CAPITAL$ seeking the recognition from the $COUNTRY_ADJ$ $MONARCHTITLE$ on his sultanate sovereignty over Perak. The Sultanate was shaken by the threat of a civil war and our military could help stabilize it. By accepting the Sultan's request and signing a friendship treaty, we will be able to establish a protectorate over Perak.
The Pahang Succession

As the Johor Empire was falling apart with the loss of the Riau-Lingga territories, Temenggung Ibrahim of Johor understood this situation and quickly signed a treaty with Bendahara Tun Mutahir of Pahang. The treaty recognizes the territories of Johor (mainland), the Temenggung and his descendent's right to rule it, mutual protection and mutual recognitions of Pahang and Johor. With the signing of this treaty, the remnants of the Empire became two independent states, Johor and Pahang. Later, Pahang was fought over in a civil war between the two sons of the reigning Bendahara of Pahang. The war ended when Wan Ahmad was proclaimed the new sultan in $YEAR$, but his role from that point onward was largely ceremonial, as the $COUNTRY_ADJ$ forced him to sign a treaty bringing the country under control of a $COUNTRY_ADJ$ Resident.
Establish the Johor Protectorate

In $YEAR$, the Sultan of Johor went to $CAPITAL$ seeking the recognition from the $COUNTRY_ADJ$ $MONARCHTITLE$ on his sultanate and Johor's independence. The Sultanate was shaken by civil war, internal strife and succession crisis. The once powerful sultanate is now a shell of its former self, weak and shaken. By accepting the Sultan's request and signing a friendship treaty and formally crowning him as the Sultan of Johor, we will be able to establish a protectorate over Johor.
Assert Independence

The rebellious government in China tried unsuccessfully to defeat the rightful government - our government - by invading Formosa, but they failed. It's time to assert our independence and negotiate with the great powers and the rebels our perpetual independence and our recognition as a free country.
Conquer Kita Ezo

Foreigner powers encroach our territory, we need to show our strength by consolidating our grip over Kita Ezo, as Russian influence grows from the west and threatens to engulf the island and its native inhabitants.
Velika Hrvatska

The concept of a Greater Croatian state has its modern origins with the Illyrian movement, a pan-South-Slavist cultural and political campaign with roots in the early modern period, and revived by a group of young Croatian intellectuals during the first half of the 19th century. Although this movement arose in the developing European nationalist context of the time, it particularly arose as a response to the more powerful nationalist stirrings in the then-Kingdom of Hungary, of which Croatia was a part.
Create the Province of Hohenzollern

The principalities of Hohenzollern-Sigmaringen and Hohenzollern-Hechingen, both independent principalities ruled by the Catholic princely lines of the House of Hohenzollern, are inherently tied to our country. The tumultuous atmosphere of the liberal revolutions left the catholic princes willing to negotiate and now they are both in a position to hand over their sovereignty to us.
Establish the Majles

Now that our great state finally has a Constitution stating the rules of the Law, we need to establish a Parliament to assure that it is uphold and the executive doesn't abuse its power. Let's unite the representatives of the people! Long live the Majles-e Shora-ye Eslami!
Found the Anglo-Persian Oil Company

The English Anglo-Persian Oil Company was the first company to extract petroleum from Iran. In 1901 William Knox D'Arcy negotiated an oil concession with Mozaffar al-Din: he would assume exclusive rights to prospect for 60 years in a vast tract of territory and in exchange the Shah received 20,000 pounds, an equal amount in shares, and a promise of future profits. In early May 1908 D'Arcy, having sunk more than 500,000 pounds into their Persian venture and found no oil, sent a telegram saying that they had run out of money and ordering to "cease work, dismiss the staff, dismantle anything worth the cost and come home." The geologist Geroge Bernard Reynolds delayed following these orders and in a stroke of luck, struck oil shortly after on May 26, 1908.
Claim Sakhalin

The eastern natural frontier of $COUNTRY$ always has been the Sakhalin islands, but our nation has been humiliated for too long by the foreign barbarians. It's time to revoke the unequal treaties, the forced terms and armistices that made the old rulers relinquish our rights over our old territory. It's time to bring the eastern border back under our control.
Selling Danish India

During the Napoleonic Wars, the British attacked Danish shipping, and devastated the Danish East India Company's India trade. In May 1801 – August 1802 and 1808 – 20 September 1815 the British even occupied Dansborg and Frederiksnagore. The Danish colonies went into decline and now it's time to find a new owner for them. Our estimative is that we can get 20,000¤ for our cities in India.
The Gadsden Purchase

Questions and disputes linger, unresolved, with Mexico. Natives on the rims of our territory attack our neighbor and we agreed to protect them from that, but the lack of control didn't help and the attacks carry on. The Mexicans also claim we owe them indemnity over the attacks and argue we agreed to pay under the conditions of our last treaty. These continuing tensions between Mexico and us complicated our efforts to find a southern route for a transcontinental railroad as the only viable routes passed through Mexican territory. Attempting to defuse the situation, $COUNTRY_ADJ$ $MONARCHTITLE$ sent James Gadsden, the new $COUNTRY_ADJ$ Minister to Mexico, to negotiate with Santa Anna. Secretary of State William Marcy instructed Gadsden to renegotiate a border that provided a route for a southern railroad, arrange for a release of $COUNTRY_ADJ$ financial obligations for Native American attacks, and settle the monetary claims between the countries related to the Garay project.\n\n§RNOTE: You need 100,000¤ to buy all the land if the Mexican government agrees to it. 50,000¤ is the minimum for the minimum land purchase.§W
The Restoration of the Miskito Kingdom
With our enemies defeated, we can force their hand in the peace deal to restore the Miskito Kingdom.
Annex the Miskito Reserve

Historically a British colony and protectorate, the Miskito Coast was claimed by $COUNTRY$ and later granted self rule under $COUNTRY$ by King George Augustus Fredric II, who accepted the change on condition that he should retain his local authority, and receive a yearly subvention of a thousand pounds until 1870. On his death in 1865, his successor, William Henry Clarence, wasn't recognized by our government and with their allies and protectors far away, organizing a quick invasion and occupation of the territory who rightfully belongs to our country should be an easy affair.
$COUNTRY_ADJ$ Wallonia

During the Belgian independence, the Walloons renamed the towns, natural features, roads and villages in their language. With the return of the rightful $COUNTRY_ADJ$ rule in the region, there would be nothing more natural than restoring the proper names.
Restoring Wallonia
The Dutch renamed all towns, signs and documents during their occupation of Wallonia. No more! It's time to restore the proper names, culture and language of the region.
The Texan Claims

Hoping that, after peace is made with Mexico, they could build a railroad to the Gulf of California to give "access to the East Indian, Peruvian and Chilean trade", the Texan leaders decided to claim the Rio Grande as the boundary with Mexico, including much of New Mexico.
Treaty of London (1864)

The Ionian Islands had been an amical protectorate of the United Kingdom ever since the end of the Napoleonic Wars. In 1862 the protectorate was deemed to expensive to maintain, and the islands were, after two years of negotiations, seceded to Greece.
Restore Istanbul
The city of Istanbul is now under our rule. It is known by many names but to signal our reconquest we should rename it back to Istanbul.
Tsargrad
The city of Istanbul is now under our rule. It is known by many names but to signal our conquest we should rename it to something more appropriate to our culture.
Restore Constantinople
The city of Istanbul is now under our rule. It is known by many names, but we should restore the old and original name of the city: Constantinople.
The Moravian Exchange
To normalize our relations after the last war, we should strike a deal with the former owner of Moravia and exchange the conquered territory for the bordering territories with a German majority.
Found Budapest

In the 18th and 19th century Pest became the natural commercial, transportation, industrial and cultural center of Hungary while nearby towns of Buda and Óbuda remained small. The Chain Bridge linking Buda with Pest was opened some time ago as the first permanent bridge across the Danube and everyday the town of Pest grows in importance, rivaling Vienna. But to have a modern metropolis, with enough space for a growing population and big enough to accommodate the ever growing Pest, it would be wise if we unified the three towns of Buda, Óbuda and Pest in one capital: Budapest.
Establish the Kaitakushi

The new Government viewed the development of Hokkaido as essential to Japan's prosperity and defense, and established the Hokkaido Kaitakushi (Development Commission) in 1869. The government invited farmers, soldiers and other immigrants from across the nation to promote the development of the wild land. The Kaitakushi also invited Horace Capron, former U.S. Secretary of Agriculture, to adopt overseas technology. The introduction of American technology helped advance both development and modernization, leading to the development of capital-intensive farming, the opening of coal mines and the construction of lumber mills, breweries and canneries that made use of local resources. With the construction and improvement of roads, ports and railways and the opening of the Seikan sea route between Honshu island (Aomori) and Hokkaido (Hakodate), urban areas will be formed throughout Hokkaido.
The Enkaishu Region

The northern coast of the Asiatic continent, known to us by the name of Enkaishu, now is firmly in our hands. Nothing better to demonstrate that, and to encourage immigration, than renaming it to proper Japanese names.
The Guanwai Region

For too long outsiders dominated Guanwai. And now we expelled the barbarians. They called these Chinese lands by foreign names for too long, replacing them all and using their barbaric language everywhere. We should restore the proper names for this region and for these provinces as soon as possible.
Abolish the Fueros

The relentless centralizing drive of the Spanish Crown led, after the end of the First Carlist War, to the reduction of the Basque institutional and legal system (called Fueros), but it was only after the last Carlist War that it was virtually wiped out. After the war, a new Spanish constitution was drawn up in order to establish a unitarian and central administration in Spain cut out according to a Spanish-Castilian pattern. Navarre was affected, but for the moment it was spared from further curtailments due to their 1841 "Compromise Act" (Ley Paccionada) that turned officially the semi-autonomous Kingdom of Navarre into another province of Spain. The Basques were forced to enroll in the Spanish military on an individual basis, and not in separate groups or corps, despite the fact that many Basques could hardly articulate a pair of phrases in Spanish, exposing them at best to stressful experiences. These changes allowed Spain to turn in a modern unified country, shaking off the last bits of the Ancien Régime, the first step to end the regionalism driving the forces behind the Carlists and Christinos.
Renaming Saint Petersburg
The war with the Germans rage on and our government has a proposal to rename the city of Saint Petersburg to Petrograd, meaning "Peter's City", to remove the German words Sankt and Burg.
Greater Norway
We are a power to be reckoned with. It is time that we claimed the lands that are part of our heritage!
A New Life in the New World

With the large political freedom that's enjoyed in our country, there's a new proposal in the upper house to boost our numbers: large numbers of Europeans can be brought to our country to work in the fields, their travel being paid by the $COUNTRY_ADJ$ government. Propaganda, incentives, paid travel ticket's and treaties can be signed with other governments so to increase the number of immigrants that arrive in our country. Come start a new life in $COUNTRY$!
Integrate Neuchatel
The Neuchatel Crisis was resolved in our favor, and we may now declare Neuchatel an integral part of our nation.
Declare the Neuchatel Republic
The Neuchatel Crisis was resolved in our favor, and we may now declare the Neuchatel Republic an integral part of our nation.
Integrate Rio Grande do Sul
Rio Grande do Sul, claimed by Brazil as part of their nation, is now in a position that facilitates their return to Brazil. We can broke a deal and oversee that the state returns to its former union.
Integrate Bahia
Bahia, claimed by Brazil as part of their nation, is now in a position that facilitates their return to Brazil. We can broke a deal and oversee that the state returns to its former union.
Integrate Pernambuco
Pernambuco, claimed by Brazil as part of their nation, is now in a position that facilitates their return to Brazil. We can broke a deal and oversee that the state returns to its former union.
The Heavenly Capital
Our forces have capture Nanjing, the Ming dynasty's former capital, and we now can decree it the Heavenly Capital - Tianjing.
Nanjing Recaptured
Our forces have capture Nanjing, the Ming dynasty's former capital, renamed Tianjing by the Taiping rebels. We need to clear the rebel stain and restore the city's historical name.
Centralizing Champasak
Champasak has existed as our vassal for decades, but as our country modernizes, we must also centralize the administration. It's time to bring them in the fold.
Claim Tibet
Tibet has long been a part of China, but during the period of chaos it broke free. It's time to return the wayward son to its motherland.
The Totalitarian System

We must finish once and for all with the neutrality of chess. We must condemn once and for all the formula 'chess for the sake of chess', like the formula 'art for art's sake'. We must organize shockbrigades of chess-players, and begin immediate realization of a Five-Year Plan for chess. Our nation took all the necessary steps and the framework for a new kind of political system, a political system in which the state holds total authority over the society and seeks to control all aspects of public and private life wherever possible. We must make all this official, tie the loose ends, and establish absolute control over society.
Ideological Indoctrination and Mass Propaganda

$COUNTRY$ recognizes that the foundation of our system depends upon complete dedication of the people to the state through education in the broad fields of engineering, the natural sciences, the life sciences and social sciences, along with basic education. With the fascist takeover, fascist ideology began to permeate the educational system and indoctrination is crucial to the success of the revolution and the perseverance of $COUNTRY$.
Ideological Indoctrination and Mass Propaganda

$COUNTRY$ recognizes that the foundation of our system depends upon complete dedication of the people to the state through education in the broad fields of engineering, the natural sciences, the life sciences and social sciences, along with basic education. With the communist takeover, communist ideology began to permeate the educational system and indoctrination is crucial to the success of the revolution and the perseverance of $COUNTRY$.
The Cult of Personality

Thank you, $MONARCHTITLE$. Thank you because I am joyful. Thank you because I am well. No matter how old I become, I shall never forget how we received $MONARCHTITLE$ two days ago. Centuries will pass, and the generations still to come will regard us as the happiest of mortals, as the most fortunate of men, because we lived in the century of centuries, because we were privileged to see $MONARCHTITLE$, our inspired leader... Everything belongs to thee, chief of our great country. And when the woman I love presents me with a child the first word it shall utter will be: $MONARCHTITLE$... The men of all ages will call on thy name, which is strong, beautiful, wise and marvelous. Thy name is engraven on every factory, every machine, every place on the earth, and in the hearts of all men. Every time I have found myself in his presence I have been subjugated by his strength, his charm, his grandeur. I have experienced a great desire to sing, to cry out, to shout with joy and happiness. And now see me--me!--on the same platform where the Great $MONARCHTITLE$ stood a year ago. In what country, in what part of the world could such a thing happen.
The Purge

In this hour I'm responsible for the fate of the $COUNTRY_ADJ$ people, and thereby I became the supreme judge of the $COUNTRY_ADJ$ people. I gave the order to shoot the ringleaders in this treason, and I further gave the order to cauterize down to the raw flesh the ulcers of this poisoning of the wells in our domestic life. Let the nation know that its existence — which depends on its internal order and security — cannot be threatened with impunity by anyone! And let it be known for all time to come that if anyone raises his hand to strike the State, then certain death is his lot.
The Great Patriotic Purge

To overcome our enemies we must have our own socialist militarism. We must carry along with 90 percent out of the total population of $COUNTRY$. As for the rest, we have nothing to say to them. They must be annihilated. Do not look in the file of incriminating evidence to see whether or not the accused rose up against the proletariat with arms or words. Ask him instead to which class he belongs, what is his background, his education, his profession. These are the questions that will determine the fate of the accused. That is the meaning and essence of the Red Terror.
Greater Iran

Iran has been historically humiliated by other powers, not least with the treaties of Gulista and Turkmanchey. The lands in the fringe of Iranian control fell to our enemies or to anarchy and our lands were taken away. Early Archaeology

Archaeology is the study of human activity, primarily through the recovery and analysis of the material culture and environmental data that they have left behind, which includes artifacts, architecture, biofacts and cultural landscapes (the archaeological record). Study of human antiquity date back in the days of the Renaissance, but in the 19th century, Archaeology evolved to a real science. Archaeologists began to investigate various areas around the world, with the study of ancient Aegean civilization being stimulated by the excavations of Heinrich Schliemann at Troy, and of Arthur Evans at Crete, whilst John Lloyd Stephens was a pivotal figure in the rediscovery of Maya civilization throughout Central America. However, the methodologies employed by these archaeologists were highly flawed by the standards of the 20th century.
Modern Archaeology

Further advancements in archaeological field methodology arose in the late 19th century. One of the pioneering figures in this was Augustus Pitt Rivers, who meticulously excavated on Cranborne Chase in southern England, emphasising that it was not only items of beauty or value that should be recorded but mundane items as well. He therefore helped to differentiate archaeology from antiquarianism. Flinders Petrie introduced systematic methodology in archaeology and preservation of artifacts. Archaeologists - once nothing more than tomb raiders - became reputable scientists.

The Mycenaean Excavations

Mycenaean Greece was the last phase of the Bronze Age in Ancient Greece, spanning the period from approximately 1600–1100 BC. It represents the first advanced civilization in mainland Greece, with its palatial states, urban organization, works of art and writing system. 

The Mycenaean Greeks introduced several innovations in the fields of engineering, architecture and military infrastructure, while trade over vast areas of the Mediterranean was essential for the Mycenaean economy. Their syllabic script, the Linear B, offers the first written records of the Greek language and their religion already included several deities that can also be found in the Olympic Pantheon.

Mycenaean Greece was dominated by a warrior elite society and consisted of a network of palace states that developed rigid hierarchical, political, social and economic systems. At the head of this society was the king, known as wanax. Mycenaean Greece perished with the collapse of Bronze Age culture in the eastern Mediterranean.

The system of military education was also reformed, and elementary education was made available to all the draftees. \n\nMilyutin's reforms are regarded as a milestone in the history of Russia: they dispensed with the military recruitment and professional army introduced by Peter the Great and created the Russian army such as it continued into the 21st century. The Singapore Strategy

It aimed to deter aggression by the Empire of Japan by providing for a base for a fleet of the Royal Navy in the Far East, able to intercept and defeat a Japanese force heading south towards India or Australia. To be effective it required a well-equipped base
column3: Singapore, at the eastern end of the Strait of Malacca, was chosen in 1919 as the location of this base
column4: work continued on this naval base and its defences over the next two decades. The planners envisaged that a war with Japan would have three phases: while the garrison of Singapore defended the fortress, the fleet would make its way from home waters to Singapore, sally to relieve or recapture Hong Kong, and blockade the Japanese home islands to force Japan to accept terms.

Funding and engineering was mainly provided by German Empire banks and companies, which in the 1890s had built the Anatolian Railway (Anatolische Eisenbahn) connecting Constantinople, Ankara and Konya. The Ottoman Empire wished to maintain its control of Arabian Peninsula and to expand its influence across the Red Sea into the nominally Ottoman Khedivate of Egypt, which had been under British military control since the Urabi Revolt in 1882.

The port of Weihaiwei serves as the base for the Beiyang Fleet (Northern Seas Fleet) for the Qing Dynasty. After the Russian Empire leased Port Arthur from China for 25 years in March 1898, the United Kingdom pressured the Chinese government into leasing Weihaiwei, with the terms of the treaty stating that it would remain in force for as long as the Russians were allowed to occupy Port Arthur. The port was primarily used as a summer anchorage for the Royal Navy's China Station and it was also used as a health resort. It served as a port of call for ships of the Royal Navy in the Far East (well behind Hong Kong in the south). Certain aspects of the administration not directly pertaining to military matters were left under Chinese control, and the port itself remained a free port until 1923.
The Ever Victorious Army

The Ever Victorious Army consisted of Chinese soldiers trained and led by an American and European officer corps. Though the Army was only active for a few years, from 1860 to 1864, it was instrumental in putting down the Taiping Rebellion. It was the first Chinese army which was trained in European techniques, tactics, and strategy. As such, it became a model for later Chinese armies. \n\n The Ever Victorious Army numbered around 5,000 soldiers at its height. It often defeated rebel forces which were numerically much larger because it was better armed, better commanded, and better trained. It was the first Chinese army to incorporate western style training and tactics, modern weaponry, and most important, the concept of light fast moving infantry units which could move faster than their opponents.

The Cremieux Decree was a law that gave French citizenship to about 35,000 Jews in French Algeria. It was named for French-Jewish lawyer and Minister of Justice Adolphe Cremieux, who had founded the Alliance Israelite Universelle a decade earlier.
